offering_description.value: Produces and sells nitrogen fertilizers, mainly urea ammonium nitrate and ammonia, to farmers and agricultural distributors in the central United States. It makes the products at two nitrogen fertilizer plants from natural gas and air-separated nitrogen, then ships them by rail, truck and pipeline.

primary_products.value: urea ammonium nitrate; ammonia; ammonium sulfate

customer_segment.value: B2B: farmers through agricultural distributors and cooperatives, industrial ammonia buyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: nitrogen fertilizers and ammonia sold to farm distributors and industrial buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes nitrogen fertilizers from natural gas, sold to distributors, cooperatives and farmers

geography_served.value: US regional: Corn Belt and Plains states, including Kansas, Illinois, Iowa and Nebraska

specialization.value: niche specialist: nitrogen fertilizer products made at two plants

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: agricultural distributors and farm cooperatives that resell to farmers; direct sales: bulk sales to industrial customers and large agricultural buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Clean Air Act and EPA Risk Management Program rules for ammonia handling, plus DOT hazardous materials transport rules
